offline.title: No internet connection
offline.body: Check that your phone is online and try again.

unavailable.title: The service is unavailable right now
unavailable.body: Try again in a little while. Nothing you saved has been lost.

update.title: A newer version of the app is available
update.body: Update the app from the App Store to keep using it.

account.signedOutBody: Apply for jobs, follow your applications and keep what you like — all from your phone.
account.adminOnWeb: Admin tools are on the website only, not in the app.
account.deleteApple: We will ask you to confirm with Apple, so the app is disconnected from your Apple ID too.
account.deleteAppleFailed: We could not confirm with Apple. Try again.
account.oauthOnlyApple: This account signs in with Apple, so there is no password to change.
account.mfaNoApp: No authenticator app on this phone opened it. Enter the key below in yours.
account.mfaDisableBody: Signing in will ask for your password only.
account.exportLimit: You have downloaded a copy of your data several times today. Try again tomorrow.

auth.captchaPrompt: Tap the box so we know you are not a program, then continue.
auth.captchaFailed: We could not load the security check. Check your connection and try again.
auth.switchTitle: You are signed in with another account
auth.switchBody: You are signed in as {email}. This link is for {other}: going on signs you out of yours on this phone and signs in with that one.
auth.mfaSignOut: I do not have the code — sign out
auth.mfaLost: Lost the phone with your authenticator app? Write to us and we will help you back into your account.
auth.linkUsedBody: It has been used already or has expired. You are signed in as {email}, so there is nothing more to do.
auth.resetLinkFailed: That link has expired or has already been used. You are signed in as {email}, so you can set a new password for it in Sign-in and security.
auth.emailChangeLinkFailed: That link has expired or has already been used, and the change has not gone through: your account’s address is still {email}. You can ask for the change again in Sign-in and security.
auth.configFailed: We could not get signing in ready. Check your connection and try again.
auth.appleRevokedBody: Sign in with Apple was turned off for this app in Settings, so we signed you out on this phone. You can sign in again at any time.

moderation.hideBody: You will not see its listings in the app on this phone again. You can bring it back at any time from “Hidden on this phone” in Account.
moderation.hidden: You have hidden this company, so its listings do not appear for you in the app.
moderation.hideAgentBody: You will not see them in the consultant directory or your shortlist on this phone again. You can bring them back at any time from “Hidden on this phone” in Account.
moderation.hiddenAgent: You have hidden this consultant, so they do not appear for you in the directory or your shortlist.
moderation.hiddenListLede: The companies and consultants you hid stay out of the app on this phone. Bring any of them back whenever you like.
moderation.hiddenNothingBody: When you hide a company or a consultant, it appears here so you can bring it back.

applications.withdrawBody: The company will no longer see it. This cannot be undone.

apply.useProfileCv: Use the CV on your profile

profile.saveFirst: Save your profile first; then you can add your experience, education and certificates.
profile.monthInvalid: Write the year and month like this: 2024-03
profile.endedHint: Leave it empty if you still work there
profile.endBeforeStart: The end date must come after the start.

applicants.cvLimit: You have opened a lot of CVs this hour. Try again shortly.

push.title: Notifications on this phone
push.hintCandidate: When your application arrives, and when the company moves it to a new stage — everything the bell tells you, as it happens.
push.hintEmployer: When someone applies to one of your listings — everything the bell tells you, as it happens.
push.denied: Notifications for Brokers Connect are turned off in your phone’s settings.
push.failed: We could not turn notifications on. Try again.
push.promptTitle: Hear about it the moment it happens
push.promptCandidate: Turn on notifications and we will tell you as soon as a company answers your application.
push.promptEmployer: Turn on notifications and we will tell you as soon as someone applies to your listings.
push.unavailable: Notifications on this phone aren't available in this version of the app yet. Everything new still reaches you in the bell, and by email if you have that on.
push.kindsBody: These apply on every phone you are signed in on. Anything turned off here still shows in the bell.
push.jobAlertsHint: Once a day, when jobs appear that match a saved search or a company you follow.
push.applicationsCandidateHint: When your application arrives, and when the company moves it to a new stage.
push.applicationsEmployerHint: When someone applies to one of your listings, or withdraws.
push.accountCandidateHint: Decisions about your account or profile, support replies, a password changed.
push.accountEmployerHint: A listing published, rejected or ending, your company’s verification, decisions about your account, support replies.
push.quietHint: Anything after 11 pm waits until 8 am, Cairo time.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: What you typed here has not been saved, and will be lost.
leave.sendingBody: Wait a moment until it is done, then you can leave.

company.docFrom: How do you want to send it?
company.cameraDenied: Allow the camera for this app in Settings to photograph the paper.

licenses.intro: This app is built on open-source software, written by many people and published for anyone to use. Here is every package in it, with its version, its licence and its copyright holders, and at the end the text of each licence.
